Components

The complete Core UI library — 47 components. Every component is CSS-first (fds-* classes, any framework), ships a React wrapper, references only semantic tokens, and responds to all theme axes — hue, saturation, mode, tonal, contrast, density, type pairing, direction. Each component has its own page with a live preview and Content, Design, Code, and Accessibility specs.

Actions (5)Inputs (11)Feedback (8)Data display (9)Navigation (9)Overlays (5)

Actions

Button

Triggers an action. Five variants form a hierarchy; one primary per view.

Icon button

A square button carrying only an icon. Requires an accessible label.

Button group

Related actions joined visually. Use for view switching or split actions.

Link

Inline navigation. Underlined so it survives without color.

Menu / dropdown

A list of actions revealed from a trigger.

Inputs

Text input & textarea

Single- and multi-line text entry with label, hint, and error.

Select

Choose one option from a short list. Native for full a11y.

Checkbox & radio

Multi-select (checkbox) vs single-select (radio) from visible options.

Switch

Immediate on/off. Unlike a checkbox it applies instantly, no submit.

Slider

Pick a value from a continuous range.

Segmented control

Exclusive choice among 2–5 peers, always visible.

Chip / tag

Compact filters, selections, or removable tokens.

Input group

An input with attached addons or buttons (prefix, suffix, action).

File upload

Drag-and-drop zone plus a file list.

Date picker

Calendar grid for single dates and ranges.

Strength meter

Segmented gauge for password strength or quotas.

Feedback

Alert

Inline, persistent message tied to a section of content.

Banner

Full-width, page-level announcement pinned above content.

Toast

Transient confirmation that appears in a corner and auto-dismisses.

Badge

Small status or count label.

Progress

Determinate progress toward completion.

Spinner

Indeterminate loading indicator.

Skeleton

Placeholder shapes while content loads.

Empty state

What users see when there is nothing yet — with a way forward.

Data display

Card

Grouped content on an elevated surface. Three elevations map to surface layers.

Stat / KPI

A headline number with label and trend.

Table

Tabular data with sortable headers, selection, and density.

List

Vertical stack of items with leading/trailing slots.

Avatar

A person or entity, as image or initials, optionally with status.

Rating

Star rating, display or input.

Timeline

Chronological events with markers.

Code block

Monospace code, block or inline.

Keyboard key

Shows a keyboard shortcut.

Navigation

Top navigation

Horizontal app bar with brand, links, and utilities.

Side navigation

Vertical, grouped navigation for app shells.

Tabs

Switch between peer views in the same context.

Breadcrumb

Shows location in a hierarchy.

Pagination

Move between pages of results.

Stepper

Progress through a multi-step flow.

Tree view

Hierarchical, collapsible navigation (files, org charts).

Mobile tab bar

Bottom navigation for phone layouts (iOS/Android idioms).

Command palette

Keyboard-first search over actions and pages (⌘K).

Overlays

Dialog / modal

Blocking overlay for focused tasks or confirmations.

Drawer / sheet

Side or bottom panel for secondary tasks that keep page context.

Popover

Non-modal floating panel anchored to a trigger.

Tooltip

Brief label on hover/focus for icon-only controls.

Accordion

Vertically stacked disclosure sections.
